
## Which file do I need?

You need Beamcam on your phone **and** on your computer.

| Your device | Download |
|---|---|
| Android phone | `Beamcam-{version}.apk` |
| Windows 11 | `Beamcam-Setup-{version}.exe` |
| Debian 13+, Ubuntu 26.04+ | `beamcam_{version}-1_all.deb` |
| Arch, Manjaro | `beamcam-{version}-1-any.pkg.tar.zst` |
| Fedora | `beamcam-{version}-1.noarch.rpm` |

Then follow [Getting started](https://github.com/JannikHerter/beamcam/blob/main/docs/user/getting-started.md).
`SHA256SUMS.txt` lets you check that a download is complete.
